gt_diagnostic_scope: Offline self-Otsu versus stored occupancy support only; no physical calls and no gate change.

definitions.nrmse: sqrt(mean((m-m_gt)^2)) / declared per-object amplitude from sealed contract
definitions.support: Unchanged stored truth mask (occupancy > .35 for E1/confirmation, original historical E3 mask); predicted foreground by 256-bin histogram Otsu
definitions.oracle: Best image NRMSE / any joint pass among AVAILABLE sealed endpoints plus selected online incumbent; GT used only here. Joint-pass counts are known-pass lower bounds if physical residual coverage is incomplete.
definitions.visualization: Lowest online physical score among shared starts; all material panels use [.02,20].
definitions.independence: Material object IDs define contracts across amplitude/grid, not independent morphology draws. Primary descriptive resampling is by fixed shape family (three in E1); layouts and starts are repeated observations.
